extension.description: Show live stock and cryptocurrency prices in the status bar while you code.
config.watchlist: Symbols shown in the status bar. Use `cn:600519`, `hk:00700`, `us:AAPL` or `crypto:BTCUSDT`. To track profit and loss, replace an entry with an object: `{ "symbol": "cn:600519", "quantity": 100, "cost": 1500 }`.
config.watchlist.quantity: How many units are held; requires `cost`.
config.watchlist.cost: Average cost per unit in the quote currency; requires `quantity`.
config.refreshIntervalSeconds: How often quotes are fetched, in seconds (minimum 15).
config.rotateIntervalSeconds: How often the status bar switches to the next symbol, in seconds (minimum 2).
config.requestTimeoutSeconds: How long to wait for a quote provider before failing over, in seconds (minimum 2, maximum 60).
config.pinnedSymbol: A symbol that stays in its own status bar item instead of rotating, for example `cn:600519`. Empty means no pin.
config.colorByDirection: Color the status bar item green when the current symbol is up and red when it is down.
config.provider: Quote source. `auto` tries finnhub when a key is stored, then tencent, then sina for stocks, and binance-vision for crypto.
